billing.plans.title: Plans
billing.payments.comingSoon: Paid plans are coming soon: payments are not set up yet.
billing.plan.free.desc: Play at home, and from anywhere directly when your router allows it. No relay.
billing.plan.basic.desc: Remote play through the Maktaba relay when a direct connection isn't possible, at up to about 3 Mbps (good 720p), on up to 2 devices at once.
billing.plan.pro.desc: Remote play through the relay at full quality, {gb} GB a month on up to {streams} devices at once. After that, playback continues at Basic quality, never stops.
billing.plan.pro.descSoon: Remote play through the relay at full quality. After its monthly allowance, playback continues at Basic quality, never stops.
billing.plan.basic.fairUse: Fair use: after 500 GB in a month, relayed streams play at lower quality until the month ends. They never stop.

billing.payg.capRequired: Set a monthly spending limit to turn on pay as you go.
payg.nearCap: You've used 80% of your pay-as-you-go limit this month.
payg.capReached: You've reached your pay-as-you-go limit. Remote play continues at Basic quality until next month.
billing.extraStreams.title: Extra devices at once
billing.extraStreams.desc: Add relayed streams beyond your plan's {streams}, at {price} each a month.

linkHome.title: Link a home account
linkHome.ask: The home at {home} asks to link this Maktaba Cloud account ({account}) to your account on it. Then you can sign in to that home through Maktaba Cloud, from anywhere, as your home account.
linkHome.rights: Linking gives this cloud account no rights in the home by itself: it signs you in as your home account, to watch. Only a home admin can allow managing the home through the cloud, for their own link, on the home. You can unlink it on the home's Account page at any time.
linkHome.broken: This link is incomplete. Start again from the home's Account page.
homes.title: Your homes
homes.intro: Watch or manage the homes your account is linked to, from anywhere, through Maktaba Cloud.
homes.none: No home is linked to this account yet. On a home, open Account → Linked accounts and link this Maktaba Cloud account.
homes.notLinked: Your account here is not linked to an account on this home: owning a home is not an account in it. Sign in on the home and link this account from its Account page.
homes.rights: The home decides what you can do there: you are your own account on it, watching only through the cloud unless you are an admin of the home who allowed managing for your own link.

billing.uptime.title: Uptime
billing.uptime.status: See how we did on the status page
uptime.policy: We aim to keep remote access available 99.9% of every month, and we publish how we did. This is a target, not a guarantee: we don't give credits or refunds for downtime.
broadcast.analytics.title: Viewers
broadcast.analytics.privacy: Places and devices with fewer than 5 viewers are grouped as "Other". We don't keep viewers' addresses or identities.
broadcast.analytics.upgrade: Countries, devices, quality and errors come with the Broadcaster add-on.
